verdict.rationale: Zero's only agent-facing surface, ZeroMCP, is authenticated by copying a full browser session cookie (Better Auth session token) into the Authorization header. OAuth is marked 'coming soon', and nothing describes issuing scoped, per-agent, or least-privilege credentials. Reusing an unscoped user session is the opposite of least privilege, so the story is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
